Name: The Daily Newspaper
Author: lopar6
Description:
Are you tired of clicking through all the TV channels every morning?
Do you wish you could have a house without a big ugly TV?
This mod delivers a daily newspaper to your front door! It allows you to check the fortune, weather, learn recipes, and see farming tips without even touching that clunky old television.

Q: Does it follow the same schedule as the TV?
A: yes

Q: Will I still be able to learn recipes?
A: yes

Q: What else can I do with the newspaper?
A: Currently the item despawns after it is used. It is used as the player interacts with it on the ground. 

Q: Will this work on multiplayer?
A: It does not currently, but It will in the near future.

Manifest.Name: The Daily Paper
Manifest.Description: Delivers a daily newspaper to the users front door containing information typically found on the TV.
